cast.name: 阿列克谢·曼韦洛夫 Alexej Manvelov
安德斯·达尔伯格 Anders Dahlberg

introduction: Are you sure that you know who you are and who your parents are? Did they tell you everything or are they keeping dark secrets from you? Ahava is 7 year old girl living in a quite neighborhood in Sweden in the 1950's. On the surface it is perfect family in the perfect home but the way the parents treat Ahava indicates that something bad is about to happen. House of Ahava is a story about the effects of Post Traumatic Stress Disorder and how horrible events experienced in the past will haunt you and change your behavior in ways that can be disastrous.
